page.layout: One printed page on this scan, text block cut off. Marginal notes in a narrow column at the right, with one further note lower down in the same margin. Page number at the top left.; One page of a table: running head at the top; below it, a ruled table with consul names in boxes on the left, years 1472–1479 in the centre column, and years 1480–1487 in the right column with reference marks; catchword "Gofen" at the bottom right.

marginalia.note: Rursum fœdus renovatum civitati cum agro vicino & novum percussum cum Ordinibus Frisiæ Orient. contra Carolum Burgundi[?].
Fridericus III. Imp. confirmavit pacta civitatis & agri, & libertatem juraque populi.

note.i: Arnoldus Lõns[?] legatus Caes. Groninge, & in Frisia Occidentali.

page.notes: The main text block is not on this part of the scan, so only the marginal notes are transcribed. "Burgundi[?]" and "Lõns[?]" are uncertain readings; the last note is set in italic. The year cells sit vertically between the lines of each name block; they are placed on the first line of each block here. The reference marks *, †, ‡ stand above the years 1481–1483 in the printed table. The name "Herman" in the first block is printed "Heı man" and is read as "Herman" with some doubt. The spelling "Gofen" and "Dulck"/"Dulek" follows the print.
